integrity: The argument is analytic and self-contained. Finite checker tests supplement but do not replace the single-crossing proof. All source comparisons are limited to the cited and retrievable literature.
scientific_limitations: Extremal statements range only over the one-parameter determinant-one block dilation of an orthogonal product of two Euclidean balls; they do not establish unrestricted affine optimality. The optimizer is generally implicit. Historical novelty has not been independently certified.
title: A sharp radial-moment phase transition for volume-preserving products of balls
